text: Use it on the lower block of any machine to upgrade that machine: its prices drop by about 30%, never below one item. The Wandering Trader Machine also pays more for the goods it buys. On a villager machine the kit stands in for curing a zombie villager. The upgrade lasts until the machine is broken; a machine that is already upgraded says so and keeps your kit.
The heart of the Shulker Machine: it goes in the middle of the machine’s recipe. Shulkers live in End cities, so you need to fight them for the nine shells first.

Use the machine to open its trade screen and trade as with a villager. Its stock never runs out. Each trade earns the machine trading XP, which unlocks its next level of offers; the table below shows how much each trade gives.

To place blocks or torches against the upper block, crouch while aiming at it (hold Sneak while flying in Creative), then stand up again to trade. If a click right after crouching does nothing, click again.

The machine is two blocks tall: place it on a floor with empty air above. Short grass or a snow layer in that space blocks it, so clear it first. Machines can stand right next to each other. Breaking a machine resets it: it loses its trade progress and its upgrade. In Survival, mine the lower block (any tool or your hand) to get the machine back; the upper block cannot be mined.
Use an Upgrade Kit on the lower block to cut its prices by about 30% until the machine is broken. Survival uses up the kit; a machine that is already upgraded says so and keeps your kit.
